entities.name: DeepSeek
entities.desc: Hangzhou. Backed by High-Flyer Quant + National AI Fund (state-led) + Tencent + CATL + Hillhouse. Models: DeepSeek-V3, V4. Cost-efficient frontier — disrupted US cost narrative Jan 2025. V4 natively optimized for Huawei Ascend; migrated fully from CUDA to Ascend-native. **Funding round (June 2026):** Raised ¥50B ($7.4B) in first-ever external round at ¥350–400B ($52–59B) valuation. Round CLOSED June 17, 2026. Final structure: all commercial investors (Tencent, CATL, others) accepted 5-year lock-up and surrendered ALL voting rights. National AI Industry Investment Fund received direct equity + voting rights + no lock-up — only voting investor. Makes DeepSeek structurally state-controlled. **Engram (May 26):** conditional memory module committing static knowledge to system RAM, freeing HBM for dynamic computation; reduces AI inference dependence on foreign HBM. **Code Harness team (May 2026):** dedicated agentic coding team explicitly benchmarking against Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Hired former Jane Street engineer Cui Tianyi (崔天一) to lead effort. **DSpark (#41, Jun 2026):** Speculative decoding framework for V4. Lightweight draft model proposes tokens; V4 batch-verifies in parallel (semi-autoregressive). 85% inference speed gain per user. Open-weight release on HuggingFace + GitHub Jun 28, 2026. **Inference chip design (#51, Jul 2026, Reuters):** ~1 year into quietly designing own AI inference chip (no tape-out reported). Goal: reduce reliance on BOTH Nvidia AND Huawei Ascend — complicates assumption Huawei consolidates China's compute layer by default. Foundry partner unconfirmed; SMIC capacity under export-control pressure is binding constraint.

entities.name: Baidu
entities.desc: China's Google. ERNIE Bot (文心一言) flagship LLM. Pivoting to AI-first strategy across search, cloud, and autonomous driving (Apollo). AI Cloud #4 in China with tight ERNIE integration.

entities.name: ByteDance
entities.desc: TikTok/Douyin parent. Massive AI infra investment. Doubao (豆包, Dòubāo) is China's #1 consumer AI app, 600M+ generative AI users in China as of May 2026. Among 10 Chinese firms cleared to buy Nvidia H200 chips (May 2026) but purchase pending Beijing guidance. **Volcengine / Seedance 2.0 / 即梦AI:** premiered *Hell Grind* — world's first full-length AI-generated feature film (95 min) — at the 79th Cannes Film Festival on May 22, 2026. 15-person team, 14 days, <$500K budget. Luc Besson's SEEN studio developing an AI animated feature using Seedance 2.0. **Seres partnership (Jun 2026):** Volcengine powers Xiaosai humanoid robot decision-making at Seres smart factory. **Server CPU (#42, Jun 2026):** Developing first proprietary Arm-based server CPU, H1 2027 debut, with Qualcomm (高通, Gāotōng) providing architecture-level design collaboration. Strategic goal: reduce AI infrastructure cost and dependency on foreign compute. Doubao (豆包, Dòubāo) assistant >600M generative AI users drives the cost imperative. **Companion AI compliance (#52, Jul 2026):** Doubao agent feature went dark July 15 under new anthropomorphic-AI (拟人化) rules; no chat history deleted, users migrated to standalone Maoxiang (猫箱, Māoxiāng) app. ByteDance routes companion demand to a dedicated app it can license and gate separately. **H200 rationing (#54):** Among firms cleared for limited Nvidia H200 purchases — cap <200K units across all approved firms combined, training only; inference workloads reserved for domestic chips (Ascend). Doubao companion-agent shutdown (July 15, 2026 / Issue #58): user-created agents on Doubao (345M MAU) switched off as the CAC-led Interim Measures for AI Anthropomorphized Interaction Services took effect; agent configurations and chat histories remain read-only until Oct 15, 2026, then become unrecoverable. Productivity and enterprise agents remain out of scope.

entities.name: Alibaba
entities.desc: Public (NYSE: BABA, HKEX: 9988). Cloud / enterprise AI leader. Qwen series open-source models. Strong in enterprise and Aliyun cloud. Qwen 3.7-Max (May 2026): latest LLM for agentic/long-horizon tasks; 35-hour autonomous operation, 1,000+ tool calls. Positions itself as 'AI factory' (人工智能工厂) across full 5-layer AI stack. RMB 380B ($53B) 3-year AI infra commitment. **Qwen Robot Suite (Jun 16, 2026):** three-layer robot AI stack — Qwen-RobotNav, Qwen-RobotWorld, Qwen-RobotManip (built on Qwen3.5-4B). Enters embodied AI race alongside AgiBot, Galbot, GigaAI. **Companion AI compliance (#52, Jul 2026):** Qwen humanlike, user-created agents pulled offline July 10 — no migration path; configurations and chat histories permanently deleted. Chose shutdown over retrofit: compliance burden exceeded companion-feature value. **H200 rationing (#54):** Among firms cleared for limited Nvidia H200 purchases, training-only restriction. **Morphi investor (#56):** Co-led record ¥1B+ angel round in embodied AI startup Morphi alongside Tencent. Qwen companion-agent shutdown (July 15, 2026 / Issue #58): consumer companion-agent features on Qwen removed as the anthropomorphized-AI Interim Measures took effect; user agent data deleted with no migration path or export window — a harder line than ByteDance's Oct 15 read-only period. **Qwen3.8-Max preview (July 19, 2026 / Issue #62):** Unveiled preview of new flagship — 2.4T total parameters, multimodal (image/video input), targeted at coding, agentic workflows and long-horizon tasks. Alibaba describes it as trailing only the top US frontier model among systems it benchmarked — but on internal evaluations only; no third-party benchmarks published at launch. Live on the Token Plan alongside Qoder/QoderWork coding platforms; open weights promised to follow. Scale jump from Qwen 3.7-Max within ~2 months puts it in the same bracket as Kimi K3 (2.8T) — notable because Alibaba owns ~36% of Moonshot, making the frontier race partly an in-house rivalry. **AliExpress DSA fine (July 20, 2026 / Issue #63):** The European Commission fined AliExpress €550M (~$625M) — the largest Digital Services Act penalty to date — for failing to adequately assess and mitigate the dissemination of illegal, unsafe and counterfeit products. Follows June 2025 preliminary findings and earlier accepted commitments; the Commission concluded ordered fixes were not made. AliExpress has until October 20, 2026 to submit a corrective action plan. Read-through: a costed template for the EU's open DSA investigation into Temu (PDD), and a new compliance-cost line for Alibaba's international commerce segment at the moment Chinese platforms have rerouted volume toward Europe.

tags.l: Claims 2nd only to US frontier — internal evals only

entities.name: Tencent
entities.desc: Public (HKEX: 700). WeChat ecosystem gives massive distribution advantage. Hunyuan (混元) model family. Invested ¥10B in DeepSeek funding round (Jun 2026), accepting 5-year lock-up and no voting rights. Tencent Cloud is China's #3 cloud provider. Enflame (燧原科技) chip startup: ~20% Tencent stake, 83.8% of 2025 revenue.

entities.name: Zhipu AI
entities.desc: Tsinghua spinout. State-backed + Alibaba/Tencent. International brand: Z.ai. Listed on HKEX January 2026; stock +300%+ since listing. Joining Hang Seng Tech Index effective June 5, 2026 — est. HK$51–92B in passive inflows via Stock Connect. **GLM-5.2 (June 13, 2026):** MIT licence — no usage restrictions. Architecture: 744B total / 40B active MoE; 1M-token context window. SWE-bench Pro: 62.1 (vs GPT-5.5's 58.6). Output cost ~$4.40/M tokens (vs $30 for GPT-5.5). Anthropic-compatible endpoint → plug-in to Claude Code, Cline, OpenClaw. First Chinese frontier model with permissive licence positioned as genuine offshore enterprise product. **GLM-5.2 (#43, Jul 2026):** Mixture-of-experts (混合专家, hùnhé zhuānjiā) model, 744B total / 40B active params, 1M-token context, MIT license, no regional restrictions. #1 open-source on Artificial Analysis leaderboard (51 pts). Runs on Huawei Ascend, T-Head, Moore Threads, Cambricon from day one. Company HK market cap crossed HK$1 trillion. **Lock-up expiry (#53, Jul 2026):** ~HK$15B of cornerstone shares unlocked; stock pre-ran the event (-17% on Jul 2). STAR Market (科创板) listing announced: plans to raise ¥15B; 2025 adjusted net loss ¥3.18B on revenue of ¥724M highlights compute capex pressure. **Touch High / 摸高 plan (#57, Jul 2026):** Founder Tang Jie's internal letter; prioritizes AGI research over near-term commercialization. Four pillars: long-range tasks, autonomous agent systems, full self-training, safety + mechanistic interpretability (机制可解释性). Timing: four days before Xi's WAIC keynote; Zhipu also participated in MOFCOM model-export-control consultations. **$1B ARR milestone (July 17, 2026 / Issue #64):** Bloomberg/36Kr reported Zhipu (Z.ai) is set to become the first Chinese AI company to cross $1 billion in annualized revenue, with ARR up roughly 15x over six months. GLM-5.2 lands within a percentage point of Anthropic's Opus 4.8 on a key agentic benchmark at roughly one-fifth the cost; Marc Andreessen called it the first Chinese model to match or beat US big-lab public models. Demand tailwinds: Anthropic export curbs pushed US firms toward Chinese open-weight models (Chinese-model token usage among affected US firms nearly doubled in late June, per Nikkei); Chinese providers now serve ~45% of OpenRouter traffic vs <2% a year ago. Milestone landed days after the Kimi K3 pricing shock hit Zhipu's HK-listed shares — revenue scale and margin durability are now the same question.

tags.l: First Chinese AI firm to $1B ARR (Jul 2026)
K3 price war threatens model-layer margins

entities.name: Moonshot AI
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2023 by former ByteDance engineers. Backed by Alibaba + HongShan. Kimi K2.6: 1T-param MoE open-weight model; 300-agent swarms, 12-hr autonomous runs; ties GPT-5.5 on SWE-Bench Pro (58.6%). ~80% cheaper per token than US equivalents. $2B raise at $20B valuation (May 2026). NDRC ordered to reject US-origin capital without government clearance (Apr 2026). **Decree 837 (#45):** Cited as example of AI startups receiving private guidance to clear US limited-partner capital ahead of new outbound investment security-review framework. **Kimi K3 launched (July 16, 2026 / Issue #59):** Flagship model released the evening of July 16, hours after a teaser video. 2.8T total parameters (MoE) — claimed largest open-source model released to date — with a 1M-token context window. Uses Kimi-Linear, a hybrid linear-attention architecture with selective state compression the company says cuts KV cache ~75% and lifts decoding throughput ~6x at 1M context. Agent Swarm coordinates up to 300 sub-agents in parallel. Pricing: $0.30/M cached input, $3/M uncached input, $15/M output with full 1M context included. Moonshot claims overall intelligence second only to the top two US frontier models and wins on some coding benchmarks vs GPT-5.5. Caveats: benchmarks self-reported at launch; long runtimes on hard agent tasks (up to ~35 min); company remains under NDRC restrictions on US-origin LP capital (Apr 2026) and was named in Anthropic's Feb 2026 distillation allegations. **Hong Kong IPO plan (July 19, 2026 / Issue #62):** Three days after the Kimi K3 release, Moonshot circulated a shareholder resolution seeking approval for a Hong Kong listing within six months (Bloomberg). Concurrently finalizing a funding round reported to value the firm above $30B — roughly 7x the $4.3B mark of December 2025 and up from $20B in May 2026. ARR reported at $300M in June (from $200M in April). To qualify for the HK listing, Moonshot is dismantling its offshore VIE structure (可变利益实体) in favor of a joint-venture model, following CSRC guidance — the same domestic-capital-markets substitution path as Zhipu. CICC (中金公司) and Goldman Sachs reportedly in talks for the mandate. Caveats: six-month timeline is a target, not a filing; the $30B round was not closed as of the report; K3 benchmark claims remain largely self-reported; NDRC restrictions on US-LP capital (Apr 2026) make the domestic/HK listing partly a constraint, not purely a choice. **K3 sign-up halt (July 19, 2026 / Issue #63):** Two days after releasing the open-source, 2.8T-parameter K3 (July 17 — largest open-weight model to date, surpassing DeepSeek-V4-Pro), Moonshot suspended new consumer subscriptions after demand overwhelmed its computing capacity (Caixin). K3's benchmark showing (topped Arena's front-end coding chart post-release) plus aggressive pricing triggered a July 20 selloff in listed Chinese AI peers — Zhipu AI and MiniMax fell sharply from June highs — as investors reset assumptions on model-layer margins. Hua Chuang Securities published a same-day impact report; Atreides' Gavin Baker called K3 a potential industry turning point. Open questions: how long the pause lasts, whether pricing covers inference cost on a 2.8T model, and whether the compute bottleneck reflects the NDRC's import-restricted training compute environment.

tags.l: Claimed largest open-source model to date
Dismantling VIE for JV structure per CSRC
Paused new K3 sign-ups Jul 19 — compute exhausted
K3 topped Arena front-end coding chart

entities.name: StepFun
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2023. Frontier multimodal AI lab. Step series models. Eyeing HK$500M Hong Kong IPO as of mid-2026. NDRC ordered to reject US-origin capital without government clearance (Apr 2026) — will limit US institutional participation in planned IPO. **Agent OS at WAIC (#55, Jul 2026):** Exhibited an agent operating system at WAIC 2026 (Jul 17–20, Shanghai) — first significant public product demo of StepFun's agent software track, spotlighted alongside Huawei's Atlas 950 SuperPoD and Dongfang Suanxin's near-memory chip. **STEPX Neo agent phone + Step AOS WAIC debut (July 17, 2026 / Issue #60):** Global public debut at WAIC of STEPX Neo, billed as the first LLM-native 'agent smartphone,' running Step AOS — an agent-native OS that schedules CPU/GPU/NPU as a unified compute layer, builds a cross-device/cross-app semantic data layer, and decomposes communication and file functions into atomic services agents can call. Built-in personal agent 'Amoo.' Four-part security frame: trusted execution environments, auditable operations, on-demand permissions revoked after use, rollback. Only agent phone certified L3 (highest open tier) under China's first national AI-terminal intelligence classification standard; named a WAIC 镇馆之宝 (star exhibit). Unveiled July 13–14 ahead of the conference. Direct rival claim: ZTE's Nubia is marketing its own 'world's first AI agent phone' at the same show. Caveats: no pricing/volume disclosed at debut; agent-phone category unproven vs incumbent Android ecosystems; company remains on the NDRC US-LP capital restriction list.

tags.l: STEPX Neo agent phone debuted at WAIC Jul 17
Step AOS — agent-native OS; L3 certified

entities.name: Minimax
entities.desc: Backed by Tencent + HongShan. Multimodal + video generation. Abab series, Hailuo Video. Listed on HKEX January 2026; stock +300%+ since listing. Joining Hang Seng Tech Index effective June 5, 2026 — est. up to HK$47B in passive inflows via Stock Connect. NDRC instructed to reduce US LP capital exposure. **Lock-up expiry (#53, Jul 2026):** 107.4M shares (34.25% of capital) unlocked, worth ~HK$40B; ~1/3 held by financial investors with strongest exit motivation. Stock pre-sold (-15% on Jul 2). Signed STAR Market listing-tutoring agreement (A-share listing planned); 2025 adjusted net loss ~$250M on $79M revenue.

entities.name: 01.AI
entities.desc: Founded by Kai-Fu Lee (李开复), AI pioneer and former Google China president. Yi model series open-source. Bridge between Chinese and global AI research.

entities.name: Vast
entities.desc: Beijing. Generative 3D and world-model AI. Tripo Studio (text/image-to-3D): ~10M users, 90K studios and enterprise clients. $200M raised at $1B+ valuation June 2026. Backed by Ince Capital + China Life Insurance (中国人寿) venture fund. NetEase partner (逆水寒/Where Winds Meet). Project Eden (伊甸园计划): announced world model for fully explorable 3D environments — unreleased as of June 2026. Founded by Simon Song (ex-MiniMax co-founder).

entities.name: Unitree Robotics
entities.desc: Private (Series D ~$6B; STAR Market A-share IPO filed Jul 2026). Products: H1, G1, Go2, H2 Plus. H2 Plus (June 1, 2026): selected as Nvidia Isaac GR00T reference platform — deepens integration with Nvidia's humanoid AI stack. Factory customers: BYD, Geely, Nvidia.

entities.name: UBTECH
entities.desc: Walker S1 humanoid robot. Deployments at automotive OEMs in Guangdong and Jiangsu. China's first publicly listed pure-play humanoid robot company. Morgan Stanley cited as top-volume humanoid shipper. **UWORLD U1 (#44, Jul 2026):** First full-size consumer humanoid robot. Consumer brand 'UWORLD'. 50+ body configs (1.60–1.85m), 88 degrees-of-freedom joints, proprietary emotional AI model (情感模型). Founder Zhou Jian (周剑). Structural shift from industrial pilot to consumer market. **ASPIRE (#45):** Nvidia open-sourced ASPIRE skill library benefits China humanoid makers incl. UBTECH, lowering software barrier for deployment but deepening Nvidia ecosystem dependence.

entities.name: Fourier Intelligence
entities.desc: GR-1 humanoid robot. Early factory pilot deployments. Notable for bipedal mobility design balancing research and industrial use cases.

entities.name: AgiBot
entities.desc: A2 humanoid robot. Well-funded. Among top-volume Chinese humanoid shipment leaders per Morgan Stanley. Strong backing from major Chinese tech and industrial investors. **RaaS deployment (#38, Jun 2026):** Announced Robotics-as-a-Service (机器人即服务) model with China Telecom (中国电信) across aviation logistics and warehouse environments. Removes capex barrier for enterprise buyers. Considered most operationally significant signal in humanoid robot commercial deployment to date. **WAIC 2026 four-product portfolio + export push (July 18, 2026 / Issue #61):** Debuted four products at WAIC: A3 Ultra flagship humanoid, X2 Edu, G2 Max, and OmniHand 3 Ultra-M dexterous hand (灵巧手). A3 Ultra: 1.74m / 60kg, 51 active degrees of freedom, 5kg per-arm payload, up to 8-hour operation with hot-swap battery and autonomous charging; NVIDIA Thor at 700 TOPS on a proprietary three-layer heterogeneous compute architecture; perception via 3D LiDAR, RGB-D, fisheye and binocular cameras; GPS+RTK+UWB fusion for centimeter-level positioning. Named a WAIC 'Gem of the Exhibition' — the only embodied-AI product among the ten selected. Internationalization (出海): overseas business now >30% of revenue this year; CE-MD and CE-RED certification (May 2025); formal European organization under William Shi as President of Europe. Caveats: Western coverage flags China's National Intelligence Law data-access obligations as a trust hurdle for overseas deployments; no pricing or unit-volume disclosure at launch; third AgiBot-ecosystem WAIC appearance covered in two weeks (Aishida #49, Swancor Qiyuan #60), so execution vs announcement cadence is the thing to watch.

tags.l: A3 Ultra debuted at WAIC Jul 18 — Gem of the Exhibition
Overseas >30% of business; CE-certified for Europe
Spy-law data obligations cloud export trust

entities.name: ROBOTERA
entities.desc: Tsinghua spinout. Pioneered full direct-drive dexterous hand (灵巧手). $200M+ raised May 2026. STAR1 + L7 (full-size biped) + M7 (upper-body). Deploying thousand-unit runs at China Post and SF Group logistics centers Q2 2026.

entities.name: X Square Robot
entities.desc: Shenzhen. $430M+ raised; Series B $276M led by Xiaomi + Sequoia China. Also Alibaba, ByteDance, Meituan. WALL-A VLA model. FIRST consumer home deployment: robot cleaning service on 五八到家 (58.com) from May 2026 — China's first commercial residential embodied AI service.

entities.name: GigaAI
entities.desc: Wuhan. SeeLight S1 (时光 S1): two-armed wheeled household humanoid unveiled May 2026. China's FIRST general-purpose household humanoid using embodied AI for autonomous real-time task planning — no hard-coded routines. Capabilities: cooking, laundry, bed-making. 100 units trialling at Wuhan tech housing. Price target: <¥100K by Jun 2027. MIIT HEIS digital ID enrolled.

entities.name: Guangdong Tianji Intelligent Systems
entities.desc: Guangdong. Manufacturing and supply chain robotic systems. Raised ~¥1B ($138M) in back-to-back Series B and B+ (May 2026), led by Hillhouse Capital (高瓴资本) and Meituan (美团). Meituan participation suggests logistics/last-mile optionality.

entities.name: Matrix Robotics
entities.desc: Shanghai (Zhangjiang). Founded by Allen Zhang (张海兴), ex-Tesla China Design and Research Center. MATRIX-3: 1.7m 65kg full-size humanoid, 3.9 km/h, 15kg dual-arm payload, 27-DOF dexterous hand, 3D-woven safety skin. Core tech: WAVE physical foundation large model. Production: 5,000 units 2026, 100,000 target 2027. Debuted BEYOND Expo Macao May 2026. RaaS (机器人即服务) ecosystem.

entities.name: Manus
entities.desc: Autonomous AI agent startup. Meta acquired for ~$2B (early 2026); Beijing vetoed deal — NDRC technology-tracing framework applied to Singapore-incorporated entity. Co-founders placed under exit ban (出境限制). Exploring ~$1B fundraise to buy back from Meta. Key case study for China's new outbound investment review regime (对外投资审查).

entities.name: Spirit AI
entities.desc: Beijing. Universal AI brain for robots — VLA (Vision-Language-Action) model platform. $435M Series A (incl. extension) in 2026 at $1.5B valuation, led by Chaos Investment + YF Capital. Tier 2 embodied AI wave — institutional-lead-backed software layer for physical robots.

entities.name: Galaxea AI
entities.desc: China-based humanoid robotics company. End-to-end embodied AI systems. Series B extended to $435M total in 2026 at $1.4B valuation, led by Jinding Capital. Part of the 2026 embodied AI unicorn cohort.

entities.name: Robotphoenix
entities.desc: Shanghai. Lightweight industrial robots. First significant Chinese robotics IPO in 2026 — listed HKEX May 18, ~$86M raised. Day 1 gain nearly 80%. First significant 2026 robotics IPO via HK. Contrast: Unitree subsequently chose STAR Market A-share route over HK.

entities.name: Leju Robotics
entities.desc: Kuavo humanoid robot. Research and early industrial focus. Part of China's broader humanoid robot ecosystem building out the supply chain.

entities.name: Huawei (AI Chips)
entities.desc: Primary domestic Nvidia alternative. Ascend 910C: mass shipments May 2026, 600K units targeted, SMIC enhanced 7nm, ~1/3 BF16 throughput of Nvidia B200. Ascend 950: next-gen, DeepSeek V4 natively optimized, triggered $5.6B ByteDance order. $12B chip revenue projected 2026. HBM supply is binding bottleneck. LogicFolding/Tau Scaling Law (May 25, ISCAS): targets 1.4nm-equivalent density by 2031. Beijing instructed firms to defer Nvidia H200 deployment to protect Huawei ecosystem.

entities.name: Cambricon
entities.desc: China's leading publicly-listed AI chip designer alongside Huawei on Beijing's government-approved AI hardware procurement list (Xinchuang extension). Targeting 500K chip deliveries 2026 (3× 2025 output). Constraints: SMIC capacity + HBM supply.

entities.name: Biren Technology
entities.desc: BR100 GPU-class chip for AI training. Anke certified May 2026 — listed on China state AI procurement list for the first time. Private. Competing in premium AI accelerator segment.

entities.name: Enflame
entities.desc: Tencent-backed AI chip startup. Founded 2018, Shanghai, by ex-AMD engineer Zhao Lidong (赵立东). Yunsui series (T30 gen 4/5/6 roadmap). **STAR Market IPO approved June 15, 2026** — last of the '四小龙 (four little dragons)' to list; plans to raise ¥6B ($888M). Tencent holds ~20% stake and contributed 83.8% of 2025 revenue. Cumulative losses ~¥4.29B over 3 years; net loss narrowed to ¥1.2B in 2025. Holds only 1.7% of China AI accelerator card market. The four little dragons: Enflame + Moore Threads + Biren + MetaX — all now listed/approved.

entities.name: Moore Threads
entities.desc: GPU maker. Strong in gaming + AI inference. MTT S4000. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement. **June 2026:** confirmed as one of two primary domestic chip platforms (alongside Huawei Ascend) now used by Chinese AI labs at the pre-training and post-training stages — a shift beyond inference-only adoption. Models using Moore Threads hardware include EvoPhys-World and others.

entities.name: Iluvatar CoreX
entities.desc: BI-V150. HPC cluster focus. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: MetaX
entities.desc: C500 series. Series C-funded AI chip startup. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: D-Robotics (Horizon Robotics)
entities.desc: Revenue-generating AI chip + software supplier to China's AV sector. RDK S100 computing platform. May 2026: integrated with M-Robots OS 2.0 (OpenHarmony-based) — key hardware partner for China's domestic robotics stack. Also supplying humanoid robot manufacturers.

entities.name: Kaihong Digital Industry
entities.desc: Shenzhen. M-Robots OS 2.0 (May 2026): China's first robot OS built on OpenHarmony (open-source Huawei OS). Enables multi-robot coordination and heterogeneous fleet management. Partners: D-Robotics (compute), Guangzhou Saite (cleaning robots), Creality 3D. Alternative to US-origin ROS2.

entities.name: Hygon
entities.desc: AMD-derived architecture. Dhyana CPUs + DCUs for AI. Anke certified May 2026 for state AI procurement.

entities.name: T-Head Semiconductor
entities.desc: Alibaba's in-house AI chip arm. Zhenwu 810E: 560,000+ units shipped to 400+ external customers across 20 industries, RMB 10B+ annualized revenue. Zhenwu M890 (May 20, 2026): 3× perf vs 810E, agent-optimized (long context, multi-model). Panjiu AL128 server (128 chips/rack). Roadmap: V900 (Q3 2027), J900 (Q3 2028). ICN Switch 1.0: 25.6 Tbps AI cluster network chip. Planning STAR Market IPO.

entities.name: CXMT
entities.desc: China's only domestically owned integrated DRAM producer. HQ: Hefei. Founded 2016. Still on US Entity List. Q1 2026: revenue ¥50.8B (+719% YoY), net profit ¥24.76B (+1,688% YoY). Listing committee review May 27, 2026 — seeking ~¥29.5B on STAR Market. Would be largest chip IPO in China's capital markets history. Driven by global DRAM price supercycle + domestic procurement shift. With YMTC, forms China's 'dual memory champion' (双存储冠军) axis. **STAR Market IPO (#42, Jun 2026):** Filed for listing. Tencent divesting ~10% stake (regulatory pressure, ~¥33.5B). ByteDance hold structure under scrutiny. IPO creates secondary exposure opportunity for semiconductor equipment makers NAURA (北方华创) and AMEC (中微公司) via CXMT capex cycle. IPO Priced (July 14–15, 2026 / Issue #58): STAR Market IPO priced at ¥8.66/share — 6.69B shares (7.69B with over-allotment), raising up to ¥66.6B ($9.8B), roughly double the original ¥29.5B plan. Implied valuation ¥579.2B (~$85B). Largest A-share semiconductor IPO ever (surpassing SMIC's 2020 listing), Asia's largest IPO of 2026, and second-largest in STAR Market history; listing expected around July 27. H1 2026 net profit guided to ¥50–57B, up more than 22x YoY, on AI-driven DRAM demand. World #4 DRAM maker at ~7.7% share (2025) and China's only mass producer of DRAM. Pricing debate: supercycle-peak memory earnings priced as durable growth; company remains on the US Entity List.

entities.name: YMTC
entities.desc: China's sole commercially operational 3D NAND flash manufacturer. Wuhan. Xtacking architecture, 200+ layers. On US Entity List since Dec 2022. Filed STAR Market tutoring (CITIC Securities), formal IPO application mid-June 2026. With CXMT forms China's 'dual memory champion' axis.

entities.name: Xpeng Turing AI Chip
entities.desc: Xpeng's proprietary AI chip for autonomous driving. 4 chips per robotaxi = 3,000 TOPS onboard compute. Powers both L4 robotaxi (GX platform) and humanoid robot Iron (铁甲). Named after Alan Turing.

entities.name: AsiaInfo Security
entities.desc: Cybersecurity arm of AsiaInfo (telecoms IT). Launched Agent Trust Framework (ATF) in response to OpenClaw agentic AI vulnerability wave (May 2026). Built on 'agent intent alignment' + 'human-AI co-governance' principles.

entities.name: Tuya Smart
entities.desc: Global IoT + AI cloud platform. AI generates 70% of company code. Deployed 6 security defence layers specifically to manage OpenClaw agentic AI risk. NYSE listed.

entities.name: Alibaba Cloud
entities.desc: #1 cloud in China. Hosts Qwen models. AI Cloud capex reacceleration confirmed in recent earnings. Qiushi June 2026 signal constructive for Alibaba Cloud multiples — directed to invest in AI vs. platform price wars.

entities.name: Huawei Cloud
entities.desc: #2 cloud in China. Strong in government and telco. Pangu model. Huawei's vertical integration (chips → cloud → device) creates differentiated sovereign AI offering.

entities.name: Tencent Cloud
entities.desc: #3 cloud in China. WeChat integration advantage. Hunyuan model on Tencent Cloud. Qiushi directed Tencent (via Meituan/PDD name) to redirect capex from price wars to AI.

entities.name: Baidu AI Cloud
entities.desc: ERNIE-powered cloud platform. Strong in AV data (Apollo). Tight integration with Baidu's search and autonomous driving business.

entities.name: Baidu Apollo
entities.desc: China's largest robotaxi operator. Fully driverless commercial service in 10+ cities including Beijing, Wuhan, Shenzhen. Sixth-generation RT6 vehicle at ~¥250K unit cost. Expanding international partnerships.

entities.name: Xpeng
entities.desc: First Chinese automaker to mass-produce an L4 robotaxi (announced May 18, 2026). Pure-vision, LiDAR-free. 4× in-house Turing AI chips = 3,000 TOPS. End-to-end VLA 2.0 model; <80ms latency; no HD maps. VLA 2.0 shared with humanoid robot Iron (铁甲). Pilot commercial ops H2 2026; fully driverless Q1 2027. Amap (高德地图) first global ecosystem SDK partner.

entities.name: Pony.ai
entities.desc: US-listed. Dual business: robotaxi + autonomous trucking. JV with GAC. One of first Chinese AV companies to achieve US listing.

entities.name: WeRide
entities.desc: Global expansion focus. Robotaxi + autonomous bus operations. Deployments in Abu Dhabi and Singapore. NASDAQ: WRD.

entities.name: Momenta
entities.desc: Data-driven AV. Backed by Toyota and GM — cross-Pacific credibility signal. Flywheel data strategy: more miles → better models → more miles. **HK IPO (#44, Jul 2026):** Listed on HKEX as 6880.HK. Cornerstone investors include Mercedes-Benz, BYD's Golden Link, GIC, Fidelity, CPIC, ChinaAMC. 14 cornerstone investors ~50% of offering.

entities.name: Huawei Smart Car
entities.desc: Supplies ADS (Advanced Driving System) to OEMs as Tier-1 supplier. Partners: AITO, Luxeed. Huawei's strategy: 'Bosch of China AV' — AI brains without building vehicles.

entities.name: MIIT
entities.desc: Ministry of Industry & Information Technology. Regulates AI, telecoms, semiconductors. Developing national agentic AI security standards in response to OpenClaw wave. Administers HEIS digital identity platform for humanoid robots. **Humanoid census (July 20, 2026 / Issue #63):** MIIT data release: China has developed 400+ humanoid robot products, more than half the global total; Chinese quadruped robots account for close to 70% of global sales. Same-day state data put China's daily AI token consumption at 140 trillion, up more than 1,000-fold since early 2024. Follows the July WAIC statement that 2026 humanoid output should exceed 100,000 units. Product-count and unit-volume metrics measure breadth, not revenue — monetization remains concentrated in a handful of vendors (Unitree: RMB 1.7B revenue, RMB 591M adjusted profit in 2025).

tags.l: Daily AI token calls: 140T, +1,000x since early 2024

entities.name: CAC
entities.zh: 国家互联网信息办公室
entities.desc: Cyberspace Administration of China. Regulates generative AI, data, online content. Co-issued first AI agent (智能体) regulations jointly with NDRC and MIIT on May 8, 2026.

entities.name: NDRC
entities.zh: 国家发展和改革委员会
entities.desc: National Development & Reform Commission. Sets 5-year plans and industrial policy. Ordered leading AI startups to reduce US LP capital exposure and reject US-origin capital without clearance (2026). Codified technology-tracing approach to outbound investment review — effectively blocked Meta's Manus acquisition.

entities.name: MOST
entities.desc: Ministry of Science & Technology. Funds basic R&D and national AI programs. Key allocator of state research grants for AI, semiconductor, and quantum computing.

entities.name: Huawei Ascend 950
entities.desc: Next-generation AI training chip (Ascend 950PR). First chip for which DeepSeek V4 was natively optimized. Triggered $5.6B ByteDance order. Target: 750K units in 2026. $12B revenue projected for Huawei AI chips in 2026.

entities.name: Zhongji Innolight
entities.desc: Shenzhen-listed (SZSE 300308) optical transceiver module maker and Nvidia supplier. Q1 2026 revenue ¥19.5B (+192% YoY); net profit ¥5.73B (+262% YoY). Became top-weighted CSI 300 constituent at 5.3% in June 2026, displacing CATL and Kweichow Moutai. Stock hit all-time high CNY 1,275 on June 3. Supplies high-speed optical interconnects connecting GPU clusters in AI datacenters. Demand driven by each new wave of hyperscaler infrastructure buildout.

entities.name: LineShine
entities.desc: National Supercomputing Center, Shenzhen (深圳国家超级计算中心). #1 on TOP500 (June 23, 2026) — 2.19 exaflops Linpack benchmark, 22% faster than US El Capitan. First Chinese system to top TOP500 since Sunway TaihuLight (神威·太湖之光) in 2017. ~14M processing cores on domestic Arm-based CPU designs; no Nvidia or AMD GPUs. Custom interconnects replace GPU-based matrix computation. Does not close the AI training gap (H100-class hardware still leads) but demonstrates China's domestic chip ecosystem maturing faster than floor-case projections.

entities.name: BYD Robotics
entities.desc: Internal division of BYD Co., Ltd. (HKEX 1211 / SZSE 002594). Confirmed June 4, 2026. Strategy: proprietary hardware + open platform supplying other robotics companies. Key competitive advantage: unmatched manufacturing cost and vertical integration (battery, electronics, assembly at scale). Dealer network (~400K units globally) cited as potential consumer robot distribution channel. No prototype, no timeline, no official product launch as of June 2026.

entities.name: Galbot
entities.desc: Beijing-based embodied AI company developing general-purpose humanoid robots. Named alongside AgiBot, GigaAI, and ByteDance as part of Alibaba's embodied AI competitive peer set in the context of the Qwen Robot Suite launch (Issue #31). Part of China's first-tier humanoid robot developer cohort.

entities.name: ModelBest
entities.desc: Chinese AI lab developing efficient language models. BitCPM-CANN and LongCat-2.0-Preview (suffix 'CANN' = Huawei Ascend software stack) are among five Chinese AI models confirmed using domestic chips (Huawei Ascend) for pre-training or post-training as of June 2026 — a notable early example of training-phase domestic chip adoption.

entities.name: Seres
entities.desc: Chongqing EV manufacturer (SZSE 601127), best known for the AITO brand (co-developed with Huawei Smart Car). Entered humanoid robotics June 2026 with the Xiaosai (小赛) robot family — ALREADY deployed in production. Xiaosai 01: chassis assembly quality inspection; Xiaosai 02: exterior vehicle configuration check. Smart factory: 1,600+ intelligent devices, 3,000+ industrial robots. Strategic partner: Volcengine / ByteDance (signed Oct 2024) — provides multimodal cloud-edge AI for robot decision-making. Further humanoid products scheduled for later 2026.

entities.name: Kunlunxing Robotics
entities.desc: Embodied AI robotics startup, Beijing. Founded March 2026. Co-founders: Ren Geng (任耕, former Huawei branch GM + Alibaba Cloud exec) + Li Auto executive. Raised several billion yuan across 3 rounds in 90 days — fastest embodied AI unicorn ramp on record. Investors: Gaorong Capital (高榕资本), GL Ventures (高瓴创投), CAS Star (中科创星), Sinovation Ventures (创新工场), C&D Capital (建发资本). Product: Kunlun World Model (昆仑世界模型, Kūnlún Shìjiè Móxíng) — dual-system architecture (high-level reasoning + low-level motion controller). Full-stack proprietary hardware. Pre-product as of June 2026.

entities.name: Anyverse Dynamics
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2025. Embodied AI (具身智能) startup. Closed angel round exceeding $200M in June 2026; pre-Series A of nearly equal size reported close to completion — total H1 2026 fundraising reaches several hundred million dollars. Lands one week after Kunlunxing's multibillion-yuan close, confirming sustained institutional-scale capital formation in China's embodied AI sector. Bear case: 140+ domestic humanoid competitors implies early price war risk before consolidation. Issue #40 coverage context: Caixin highlighted this risk explicitly.

entities.name: Booster Robotics
entities.desc: Shenzhen. Full-size bipedal humanoid robot developer. Competed in the Humanoid Robot Football Penalties Challenge final at MWC Shanghai 2026 (Jun 24–26), organized by GSMA. Part of China's open-competition-as-testing-infrastructure ecosystem — public tournaments test irregular terrain, adversarial contact, and dynamic obstacle avoidance at scale. Represents the emerging cohort of competition-circuit humanoid developers contributing to China's physical AI iteration speed.

entities.name: NAURA Technology
entities.desc: Beijing. Leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturer. Key product lines: CVD, PVD, etch, thermal processing, and cleaning equipment for wafer fabs. Direct beneficiary of China's semiconductor self-sufficiency drive. Visible order pipeline from CXMT's STAR Market IPO capex cycle (#42). Critical node in China's ambition to reduce dependency on ASML, Applied Materials, and Lam Research.

entities.name: AMEC
entities.desc: Shanghai. Advanced semiconductor etch equipment maker. One of the few Chinese companies with etch tools competitive at advanced nodes. Key supplier for domestic wafer fabs including CXMT and SMIC. Benefits from CXMT's STAR Market IPO capex ramp (#42). Co-beneficiary with NAURA of China's equipment localization push under export control pressure.

entities.name: DJI
entities.desc: Shenzhen. World's largest consumer and commercial drone maker. Products: Phantom, Mavic, Agras (agricultural), Matrice (industrial). Under US Entity List restrictions since 2020. **CAAC Airworthiness Regime (#45, July 1 2026):** China's first binding statutory drone framework takes effect — manufacturers must hold CAAC airworthiness certificate (适航证), engrave unique ID on each unit, retain production records 10 years. Certification regime expected to advantage scaled incumbents like DJI with balance sheets to clear compliance; enforcement intensity over next two quarters is key variable.

entities.name: EHang
entities.desc: Guangzhou. Listed NASDAQ (EH). Leading eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) manufacturer. EH216-S passenger autonomous aerial vehicle received China's first civil aircraft type certificate from CAAC in 2023. **CAAC Airworthiness Regime (#45, July 1 2026):** New mandatory certification framework — EHang as early mover with existing type certificate is well-positioned; certification throughput at CAAC over next two quarters determines whether the regime creates a moat or bottleneck for the low-altitude economy (低空经济, projected ¥2T+ by 2030).

entities.name: Meituan
entities.desc: Beijing. Food delivery and local-services super-app — China's dominant platform for dining, hotel, travel, bike-share, and grocery delivery. Not a pure AI play, but committed to frontier AI: LongCat-2.0 (Jul 2026) is a 1.6T-parameter MoE model (48B activated per token, 1M-token context) trained end-to-end on ~50,000 domestic accelerators — the first publicly claimed trillion-parameter pretraining run on non-NVIDIA silicon. Same-day inference adaptations confirmed by Huawei Ascend, Moore Threads (摩尔线程), and MetaX (沐曦). CEO Wang Xing (王兴) framed AI as a "must-answer question" after a three-year build. Domestic-chip training claim, if verified, would be significant evidence for export-control bypass at frontier scale.

entities.name: Zeroth
entities.desc: Suzhou. Connected to Suzhou JoyIn Intelligent Technology. Home-focused embodied AI startup. ¥500M (~$74M) pre-Series A led by Ant Group (蚂蚁集团); total ~$147M raised. Investors: Ant Group, Geely Capital, 37 Interactive Entertainment, Hua Capital. 30,000+ robot orders; 600% YoY revenue growth H1 2026. Products: M1 (small humanoid), W1 (tracked robot), Jupiter (full-size home companion), N1 (collaborative, heterogeneous-arm system). Market thesis: first consumer humanoid wave is home companionship, not factory deployment — Ant + Geely + gaming publisher cap table reads as strategic distribution rather than financial capital. Regulatory wrinkle: embodied companion robots sit uncomfortably close to the new anthropomorphic-AI rules that forced Qwen and Doubao offline (#52).

entities.name: DexForce
entities.desc: Shenzhen. Founded 2021. Embodied AI platform company — NOT a robot maker. DexVerse platform spans synthetic data generation, 3D perception, skill and task generation, and model training; deployed in industrial cells for inspection, picking and dexterous manipulation. ¥1B (~$143M) Series B at ¥10B+ valuation — funded entirely by state-linked capital: Shenzhen Capital Group (深创投), Qianhai Fund of Funds (前海母基金), Hengjian Asset Management (恒健), ICBC Capital (工银资本). ¥100M H1 2026 revenue; targeting ¥300M+ full year. Structural signal: with US LP capital screened out by NDRC requirements, embodied-AI engine vendors are now funded wholly by state-capital syndicates — patient but political, selecting for SOE procurement pipelines rather than consumer stories.

entities.name: Dongfang Suanxin
entities.desc: China. 3D near-memory computing (近存计算, jìncún jìsuàn) chip startup. Exhibited at WAIC 2026 (Jul 17–20, Shanghai) — spotlighted by state media alongside Huawei's Atlas 950 SuperPoD and StepFun's agent OS, marking first significant state-platform endorsement. Near-memory computing addresses the memory-bandwidth wall that constrains domestic AI accelerators: placing compute closer to storage reduces latency and energy per operation, a globally scarce theme. Pre-product public profile as of Jul 2026; WAIC debut is the entry checkpoint.

entities.name: Nexchip Semiconductor
entities.desc: Hefei. Founded 2015 as JV between Hefei city government investment arm and Taiwan's Powerchip (力晶, Lìjīng). China's 3rd-largest wafer foundry after SMIC and Hua Hong (华虹); 8th-largest globally. Mature-node manufacturing: display driver ICs, power management chips, image sensors — the unglamorous, high-volume end of semiconductors. Dual-listed: STAR Market + **HK IPO (Jul 10, 2026):** Raised HK$6.98B ($891M) at HK$32.30/share (top of range), a 57% discount to A-share close; +14% Day 1 gain; 216.2M shares sold. Extends pattern of HK primary market as funding channel for domestic semiconductor expansion. **Phase IV fab:** ¥35.5B project, 55,000 wafers/month at 28nm/40nm; equipment move-in end of Q2 2026; full capacity Q2 2028. Risk: mature-node overcapacity building across China simultaneously — anti-involution dynamics could hit driver-IC pricing.

entities.name: Morphi
entities.desc: Beijing. Founded 2025. Embodied intelligence startup with no product launched. Co-founded by Huang Qingqiu (黄青虬) — former head of Huawei's autonomous-driving AI division, oversaw ADS 1.0-to-4.0 evolution and end-to-end architecture commercialization — and Gao Wenli. **¥1B+ angel round (Jul 2026):** China's largest first institutional round in embodied AI. Alibaba + Tencent co-led; BlueRun, Legend Capital, Source Code Capital, CAS Star and others participating. Post-money valuation: >¥7B. Investment thesis: Huawei's data-flywheel approach (iterative real-world interaction data → better models) transfers from autonomous driving to general robotics. Industry estimates put all usable real-robot interaction data globally at ~500,000 hours — the scarcity the thesis must solve. Contrasts with DexForce (#55): both raise ¥1B, but Morphi is platform-capital (strategics buying founder pedigree) while DexForce was wholly state capital.

entities.name: LimX Dynamics
entities.desc: Shenzhen. General-purpose humanoid robot developer. **"Big brain / small brain" (大脑小脑, dànǎo xiǎonǎo) architecture:** whole-body motion foundation model + VLA (vision-language-action) action layer + LLM-driven embodied agent OS. **Pre-IPO round (Jul 2026):** ~$200M; ~$400M total raised in 6 months. UAE-based Stone Venture made consecutive follow-on investments — example of Gulf sovereign-adjacent capital substituting for US LP money restricted by NDRC framework. Thousands of robot orders placed; majority from overseas (Middle East, Europe, Asia). Pre-IPO label signals the humanoid listing pipeline is forming behind first movers. Caveats: order counts are company-reported off a small base; Pre-IPO commits to no venue or timeline.

entities.name: NBS
entities.desc: National Bureau of Statistics — China's official data agency; publishes GDP, retail sales, industrial output, fixed asset investment, CPI/PPI. Q2 2026 GDP released July 15, 2026: +4.3% YoY, slowest since Q4 2022 and first quarter below the 4.5–5.0% target band since Covid. June retail +1.0% YoY with autos −16.1%; exports carried industrial output. Late-July Politburo is the policy-response venue to watch. **June 70-city home prices (released July 15–16, 2026 / Issue #59):** New-home prices -3.3% y/y (36th consecutive annual decline, mildest since Feb 2026), -0.15% m/m vs -0.2% in May. Cities with m/m gains rose to 20 (from 16 in May) — most since May 2025. Shanghai new homes +3.1% y/y, the standout. Second-hand prices -0.32% m/m, worst in four months; first-tier second-hand -4.9% y/y. Credit backdrop: outstanding bank loan growth slowed a 15th straight month to 5.2% y/y with household borrowing weak — stabilization signal in new-home prices not yet confirmed by secondary market or credit demand.

tags.l: Jun new homes -3.3% y/y, mildest since Feb

entities.name: World AI Cooperation Organization (WAICO)
entities.zh: 世界人工智能合作组织
entities.desc: Proposed China-led international AI governance body, to be headquartered in Shanghai. Xi Jinping (习近平) used his first-ever WAIC keynote (opening ceremony, July 17, 2026, alongside UN Secretary-General Guterres, Kazakh President Tokayev, and Thai PM Anutin) to elevate the initiative — an institutional vehicle for the Global AI Governance Initiative, framed around rejecting technology monopolies, providing 'international public goods,' and Global South capacity building. Positioned as an alternative pole to Western-led AI governance frameworks. Charter, membership, and funding details not yet published.

entities.name: Swancor Qiyuan
entities.desc: Personal-robot brand of Swancor Advanced Materials, the STAR Market composites maker whose control changed in November 2025 to Zhiyuan (AgiBot)-affiliated vehicles (Zhiyuan Hengyue ~29.99%) in the cycle's highest-profile robotics backdoor-listing (借壳上市) play. CEO Tian Hua is ex-Huawei (wireless, NE Europe VP; computing product line CBO) and ex-AgiBot (ecosystem GM, chief supply officer). Launched the Qiyuan brand Dec 31, 2025 with the Q1 — an 88 cm, 15 kg claimed 'world's smallest full-body force-controlled humanoid' aimed at developers/consumers, with open SDK/HDK and modular 3D-printable shells. **Quester1 WAIC debut (July 17, 2026 / Issue #60):** shape-shifting personal robot that auto-switches between wheeled-bipedal and quadruped forms on a single chassis ('transformer cross-morphology integrated architecture'); target scenarios: home companionship, outdoor escort, smart filming. Strategy: define the 'personal robot' category before it matures; offline experience stores planned in Shenzhen and Shanghai; pricing undisclosed. Materials synergy: parent's lightweight composites feed robot bodies.

tags.l: Quester1 shape-shifting robot debuted at WAIC Jul 17

entities.name: PBOC
entities.desc: People's Bank of China — central bank. Monetary policy stance 'moderately loose' since Dec 2025 CEWC; 7-day reverse repo 1.40%, overnight facility 1.30% (corridor since June 2026). **Week-ahead (July 20–24, 2026 / Issue #60):** July LPR fix due Monday July 20 — first rate decision after Q2 GDP printed 4.3%. Consensus: unchanged; quantity tools favored over price tools; late-July Politburo the main venue for H2 policy signals. **July LPR fix (July 20, 2026 / Issue #62):** Monthly LPR quotations due with the Reuters survey pointing to a 14th consecutive month on hold — 1-year at 3.0%, 5-year at 3.5%, both record lows unchanged since May 2025 — despite Q2 GDP slowing to 4.3%, the weakest in 3.5 years and the first sub-target quarter since Covid. Survey outlook was divided, a shift from prior unanimous-hold months. A hold pushes the easing decision to the late-July Politburo (政治局) meeting; the rate corridor narrowing and 'moderately loose' (适度宽松) stance remain the operating framework, with most economists pushing the next cut to 2027.

tags.l: Quantity tools over price tools since May 2026
LPR fix Jul 20 — 14th month on hold expected
Q2 GDP 4.3% — first sub-target quarter since Covid
Easing burden shifts to late-July Politburo

entities.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA)
entities.desc: China's foreign ministry — increasingly the public voice for Beijing's AI diplomacy (WAICO, open-source-as-public-good framing). **July 18, 2026 (Issue #61):** Assistant Foreign Minister Liu Bin (刘彬) used the WAIC stage to dismiss allegations by Anthropic and other US labs that Chinese developers illicitly 'distill' (蒸馏) outputs from frontier American models: 'Some countries hype up distillation.' The rebuttal, without naming the US, signals the extraction dispute has moved from lab-to-lab accusation to state-level talking point — relevant to how model-provenance claims get litigated in export-control and IP venues.

tags.l: Dismissed US distillation claims at WAIC Jul 18
AI diplomacy lead: WAICO, open-source framing

entities.name: SAFE
entities.desc: State Administration of Foreign Exchange — manages China's $3.2T+ FX reserves and capital-account controls; the data source of record for cross-border flows. **H1 2026 FX data (July 17, 2026 / Issue #61):** Newly signed corporate FX hedging (套期保值) contracts +40% y/y to nearly $1.4T; hedging ratio 35.3% of corporate FX transactions (+5.3pp) as the yuan appreciated ~3.5%. Record $2.9T bank FX settlement; $9.2T cross-border receipts/payments (+20%+). Reiterated 'risk-neutral' (风险中性) guidance against currency speculation while easing derivative access.

entities.name: CXMT (ChangXin Memory)
entities.desc: Hefei-based DRAM maker, China's leading domestic memory-chip champion and centerpiece of the localization push under US export controls. Priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at ¥8.66/share on July 16, 2026, raising ~$8.5–10B — China's largest-ever A-share semiconductor offering and its biggest listing since 2010. Retail tranche ~212x oversubscribed; implied valuation near $85B. Debut scheduled July 27, 2026 — landing into a STAR Market down ~25% from its July 1 high and propped up by state-fund buying, making the first session a live test of primary-market risk appetite.

tags.l: Debuts Jul 27 into a -25% STAR market

entities.name: Central Huijin
entities.desc: Domestic investment arm of China's sovereign wealth fund (CIC) and the anchor of the 'national team' (国家队) that buys equities to stabilize markets. July 2026: PBOC said it would provide relending to back Huijin purchases as state buyers — China Reform Holdings (国新) and China Chengtong (诚通) — deployed ≥¥60B (~$8.9B) from July 19 to halt a tech-led rout that took the STAR Market down ~25% from its July 1 high. Record inflows into tech ETFs followed. Relending-financed equity support blurs the monetary–fiscal boundary and is the mechanism to watch.

tags.l: Anchor of the 'national team' 国家队
PBOC relending backs its equity buying (Jul 2026)

entities.name: CSRC
entities.desc: China Securities Regulatory Commission — securities and futures regulator, chaired by Wu Qing (吴清) since 2024. Runs IPO registration (approved Unitree in a record 73–104 days; CXMT's mega-IPO) and coordinates market-stabilization policy. July 2026: Wu pledged 'all efforts' to safeguard stability as the national team deployed ≥¥60B against a tech-led rout; formalized a 'stability-first' counter-cyclical framework in January 2026.

tags.l: Wu Qing 'all efforts' stability pledge Jul 2026
Gatekeeper of the AI/robotics IPO calendar
